flashcard_questions.q: An organism such as a bacterium or fungus that breaks down dead organic matter, recycling nutrients back into the ecosystem.
An organism too small to see without a microscope, such as a bacterium or fungus.
An organism that feeds on dead organic matter (detritus), starting the process of decay — examples include maggots, earthworms, and woodlice.

flashcard_questions.a: A biological catalyst — a protein that speeds up chemical reactions without being used up.
The breakdown of dead organic matter by microorganisms, recycling nutrients such as carbon and nitrogen back into the soil and atmosphere.
